packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for the minor, patch, digest and pin updates of everything (npm and pnpm, Dockerfile base images, GitHub Actions, the image tools and the MariaDB image in ci.yml and verify-image.sh). A major update is NOT in it: it gets a pull request of its own, so a breaking change is reviewed alone and cannot hold up the weekly one. Security updates are never grouped: they are separate pull requests, raised at any time.

MariaDB stays on 11.4: the version the server runs (infra/bootstrap), CI tests against and docker-compose.dev.yml starts. For the docker versioning 11.4 to 11.8 is a minor update, which the weekly group would otherwise carry. The rule is by package name, so it covers every place Renovate reads the image: the services in ci.yml and deploy.yml, docker-compose.dev.yml, and the verifier's client image (the custom manager below). New builds of 11.4 (digest updates) still come through.

customManagers.description: Docker images that ci.yml runs as containers and pins as name@sha256:digest # version (hadolint, Trivy). The Dockerfile and GitHub Actions managers do not read these.

The MariaDB image that infra/images/verify-image.sh runs as its database client, pinned as name:tag@sha256:digest. It is the same image as the MariaDB service in ci.yml (which Renovate reads by itself), so both are bumped in the same weekly pull request.
